Reference / runtime/fs

runtime/fs#

The native layer under db/sqlite, fs/directory, fs/entry, fs/file: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under db/sqlite, fs/directory, fs/entry, fs/file: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

native file_state_open#

native file_state_open(path is @byte, mode is int, encoding is string) is FileState

Lazy high-level file state. mode is FileMode's stable 0..4 ABI code. Text or bytes are left open: the first text or byte operation picks them (#352), and an operation of the other kind then fails with invalid_input. encoding is one of the canonical portable names and applies when text is picked.

native file_state_flush#

Checks that state is open for writing; writes reach the host unbuffered, so nothing is held back, but nothing is durable yet either.
